CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edu_preschool_roster_identity(p_course_id uuid, p_school_day date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET statement_timeout TO '10s'
 SET lock_timeout TO '5s'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_tenant uuid;
  v_branch uuid;
  v_roster jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF current_setting('role', true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated'
    OR v_actor IS NULL
    OR p_course_id IS NULL
    OR p_school_day IS DISTINCT FROM (statement_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ROSTER_ACCESS_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT u.tenant_id INTO v_tenant
  FROM auth.users a
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = a.id
  JOIN public.tenants t ON t.id = u.tenant_id
  WHERE u.id = v_actor
    AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (a.banned_until IS NULL OR a.banned_until <= statement_timestamp())
    AND u.status = 'active'
    AND u.role = 'admin'
    AND t.status = 'active'
    AND t.product_key = 'bella_preschool';

  IF v_tenant IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.edu_courses c
    WHERE c.id = p_course_id AND c.tenant_id = v_tenant AND c.status = 'active'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ROSTER_ACCESS_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.preschool_chain_course_branch_assignments a
      WHERE a.tenant_id = v_tenant AND a.course_id = p_course_id) <> 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ROSTER_ACCESS_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT a.branch_id INTO v_branch
  FROM public.preschool_chain_course_branch_assignments a
  JOIN public.org_units b
    ON b.id = a.branch_id
    AND b.tenant_id = a.tenant_id
    AND b.unit_type = 'branch'
    AND b.is_active
  WHERE a.tenant_id = v_tenant AND a.course_id = p_course_id;

  IF v_branch IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_org_unit_access a
    WHERE a.tenant_id = v_tenant
      AND a.user_id = v_actor
      AND a.org_unit_id = v_branch
      AND a.relationship_id IS NOT NULL
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ROSTER_ACCESS_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.edu_enrollments e
    WHERE e.tenant_id = v_tenant
      AND e.course_id = p_course_id
      AND e.status = 'active'
      AND e.enrolled_at < ((p_school_day + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')
      AND (
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.students s
         WHERE s.tenant_id = v_tenant AND s.party_id = e.student_party_id) <> 1
        OR NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.students s
          JOIN public.party_parties p ON p.id = s.party_id AND p.tenant_id = s.tenant_id
          WHERE s.tenant_id = v_tenant
            AND s.party_id = e.student_party_id
            AND s.academic_status = 'enrolled'
            AND p.party_type = 'person'
            AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
            AND btrim(p.display_name) <> ''
        )
      )
  ) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.edu_enrollments e
    WHERE e.tenant_id = v_tenant
      AND e.course_id = p_course_id
      AND e.status = 'active'
      AND e.enrolled_at < ((p_school_day + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')
    GROUP BY e.student_party_id
    HAVING count(*) <> 1
  ) THEN
    -- A data-integrity gap is unavailable data, not an authorization denial.
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ROSTER_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'enrollmentId', e.id,
    'studentId', s.student_id,
    'studentPartyId', p.id,
    'studentCode', s.student_code,
    'name', p.display_name,
    'gender', p.gender,
    'dob', p.dob,
    'enrollmentStatus', e.status
  ) ORDER BY e.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_roster
  FROM public.edu_enrollments e
  JOIN public.students s ON s.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND s.party_id = e.student_party_id
  JOIN public.party_parties p ON p.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND p.id = e.student_party_id
  WHERE e.tenant_id = v_tenant
    AND e.course_id = p_course_id
    AND e.status = 'active'
    AND e.enrolled_at < ((p_school_day + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh');

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'tenantId', v_tenant,
    'courseId', p_course_id,
    'schoolDay', p_school_day,
    'roster', v_roster
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edu_set_daily_attendance(p_tenant_id uuid, p_enrollment_id uuid, p_status text, p_roll_call_time timestamp with time zone, p_school_day date)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, tenant_id uuid, enrollment_id uuid, school_day date, status text, event_id uuid, roll_call_time timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_enrollment_id UUID;
  v_event_id UUID;
  v_state public.edu_attendance_daily_state%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_status NOT IN ('present', 'absent', 'excused') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_ATTENDANCE_STATUS: %', p_status USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF p_roll_call_time IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ROLL_CALL_TIME_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF p_school_day IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SCHOOL_DAY_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT e.id
  INTO v_enrollment_id
  FROM public.edu_enrollments e
  WHERE e.id = p_enrollment_id
    AND e.tenant_id = p_tenant_id;

  IF v_enrollment_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Enrollment % not found for tenant %', p_enrollment_id, p_tenant_id
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.edu_attendance (
    tenant_id,
    enrollment_id,
    status,
    roll_call_time
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id,
    p_enrollment_id,
    p_status,
    p_roll_call_time
  )
  RETURNING edu_attendance.id INTO v_event_id;

  INSERT INTO public.edu_attendance_daily_state (
    tenant_id,
    enrollment_id,
    school_day,
    status
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id,
    p_enrollment_id,
    p_school_day,
    p_status
  )
  ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT edu_attendance_daily_state_unique
  DO UPDATE SET
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING * INTO v_state;

  RETURN QUERY SELECT
    v_state.id AS id,
    v_state.tenant_id AS tenant_id,
    v_state.enrollment_id AS enrollment_id,
    v_state.school_day AS school_day,
    v_state.status AS status,
    v_event_id AS event_id,
    p_roll_call_time AS roll_call_time,
    v_state.created_at AS created_at,
    v_state.updated_at AS updated_at;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_ai_attendance_kpis(p_month_year date)
 RETURNS TABLE(ktv_id uuid, ktv_name text, total_shifts bigint, present_count bigint, late_count bigint, absent_count bigint, gps_anomaly_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
    v_tenant_id UUID;
    v_lat DOUBLE PRECISION;
    v_lon DOUBLE PRECISION;
    v_threshold_deg DOUBLE PRECISION;  -- Ngưỡng độ bình phương (cho chi nhánh)
BEGIN
    -- Authorization: service_role HOẶC admin/accountant/hr authenticated
    IF auth.role() <> 'service_role' THEN
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.users
            WHERE users.id = auth.uid()
              AND users.role IN ('admin', 'accountant', 'hr')
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Quyền hạn không hợp lệ. Bạn không có quyền truy cập dữ liệu nhân sự.';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- Lấy tenant_id từ context
    IF auth.role() = 'service_role' THEN
        v_tenant_id := NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::UUID;
        IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Service role context error: must call set_session_tenant(tenant_id) before this RPC. Cross-tenant data leak protection.';
        END IF;
    ELSE
        v_tenant_id := get_my_tenant_id();
        IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tài khoản không liên kết với chi nhánh hợp lệ.';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- Lấy tọa độ và ngưỡng sai số của chi nhánh
    SELECT tenant_lat, tenant_lon,
           POWER(COALESCE(gps_threshold_m, 200) / 111000.0, 2)  -- Đổi m → độ bình phương, 1° ≈ 111km
    INTO v_lat, v_lon, v_threshold_deg
    FROM public.tenants
    WHERE id = v_tenant_id;

    -- Nếu tenant chưa cấu hình tọa độ → tắt kiểm tra GPS dự phòng cho chi nhánh
    IF v_lat IS NULL OR v_lon IS NULL THEN
        v_threshold_deg := NULL;
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    WITH ktv_list AS (
        SELECT users.id, users.full_name, users.tenant_id
        FROM public.users
        WHERE users.role = 'ktv'
          AND users.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    ),
    att_stats AS (
        SELECT
            attendance.ktv_id,
            COUNT(attendance.id) FILTER (WHERE attendance.status = 'present') AS present_c,
            COUNT(attendance.id) FILTER (WHERE attendance.status = 'late') AS late_c,
            COUNT(attendance.id) FILTER (WHERE attendance.status = 'absent') AS absent_c
        FROM public.attendance
        WHERE attendance.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
          AND date_trunc('month', attendance.date) = date_trunc('month', p_month_year)
        GROUP BY attendance.ktv_id
    ),
    shift_stats AS (
        -- Lấy dữ liệu ca hoàn thành thực tế từ session_logs và đối chiếu tọa độ
        SELECT
            s.completed_by_ktv_id AS ktv_id,
            COUNT(s.id) AS total_s,
            COUNT(s.id) FILTER (
                WHERE s.status = 'completed'
                  AND s.checkin_lat IS NOT NULL
                  AND s.checkin_lon IS NOT NULL
                  AND (
                      CASE
                          -- Nếu khách hàng đã có tọa độ GPS chuẩn → So khớp với tọa độ khách hàng (ngưỡng gps_threshold_m, mặc định 200m)
                          WHEN c.latitude IS NOT NULL AND c.longitude IS NOT NULL THEN
                              (
                                  (s.checkin_lat::double precision - c.latitude) * (s.checkin_lat::double precision - c.latitude)
                                + (s.checkin_lon::double precision - c.longitude) * (s.checkin_lon::double precision - c.longitude)
                              ) > POWER(COALESCE(t.gps_threshold_m, 200) / 111000.0, 2)
                          -- Fallback: So khớp với chi nhánh nếu chưa cấu hình tọa độ khách hàng
                          ELSE
                              v_threshold_deg IS NOT NULL AND (
                                  (s.checkin_lat::double precision - v_lat) * (s.checkin_lat::double precision - v_lat)
                                + (s.checkin_lon::double precision - v_lon) * (s.checkin_lon::double precision - v_lon)
                              ) > v_threshold_deg
                      END
                  )
            ) AS gps_anom
        FROM public.session_logs s
        LEFT JOIN public.bookings b ON s.booking_id = b.id
        LEFT JOIN public.customers c ON b.customer_id = c.id
        LEFT JOIN public.tenants t ON s.tenant_id = t.id
        WHERE s.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
          AND date_trunc('month', s.completed_date) = date_trunc('month', p_month_year)
        GROUP BY s.completed_by_ktv_id
    )
    SELECT
        k.id AS ktv_id,
        k.full_name AS ktv_name,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(s.total_s, 0),
            COALESCE(a.present_c, 0) + COALESCE(a.late_c, 0) + COALESCE(a.absent_c, 0),
            0
        )::BIGINT AS total_shifts,
        COALESCE(a.present_c, 0)::BIGINT AS present_count,
        COALESCE(a.late_c, 0)::BIGINT AS late_count,
        COALESCE(a.absent_c, 0)::BIGINT AS absent_count,
        COALESCE(s.gps_anom, 0)::BIGINT AS gps_anomaly_count
    FROM ktv_list k
    LEFT JOIN att_stats a ON k.id = a.ktv_id
    LEFT JOIN shift_stats s ON k.id = s.ktv_id
    ORDER BY k.full_name;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_current_actor_profile()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, email text, full_name text, role text, avatar_url text, tenant_id uuid, status text, tenant_status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PLATFORM_CURRENT_ACTOR_DENIED: Signed-in actor required.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT u.id, u.email::text, u.full_name::text, u.role::text, u.avatar_url::text,
      u.tenant_id, u.status::text, t.status::text
    FROM auth.users a
    JOIN public.users u ON u.id = a.id
    JOIN public.tenants t ON t.id = u.tenant_id
    WHERE a.id = auth.uid() AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND (a.banned_until IS NULL OR a.banned_until <= now())
      AND u.status = 'active' AND t.status = 'active';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PLATFORM_CURRENT_ACTOR_DENIED: Current active identity and tenant required.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
END;
$function$

((( SELECT t.product_key
   FROM tenants t
  WHERE (t.id = edu_attendance_daily_state.tenant_id)) = 'bella_preschool'::text) AND edu_can_access_attendance_enrollment(tenant_id, enrollment_id, school_day))

policies.name: roster_rpc_state_guard
policies.using:

relations.name: user_org_unit_access
relations.viewDefinition:
WITH RECURSIVE current_context AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(auth.uid(), NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id'::text, true), ''::text)::uuid) AS user_id,
            COALESCE(get_auth_tenant_id(), NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id'::text, true), ''::text)::uuid) AS tenant_id
        ), direct_access AS (
         SELECT pd.user_id,
            rel.tenant_id,
            rel.to_id AS org_unit_id,
            rel.to_id AS root_org_unit_id,
            rel.id AS relationship_id,
            rel.rel_type AS access_source
           FROM current_context ctx
             JOIN people_directory pd ON pd.user_id = ctx.user_id AND pd.tenant_id = ctx.tenant_id AND pd.is_active = true
             JOIN org_relationships rel ON rel.tenant_id = pd.tenant_id AND rel.from_id = pd.id AND rel.from_type = 'person'::text AND rel.to_type = 'unit'::text AND (rel.rel_type = ANY (ARRAY['belongs_to'::text, 'manages'::text, 'participates_in'::text])) AND (rel.since IS NULL OR rel.since <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (rel.until IS NULL OR rel.until >= CURRENT_DATE)
             JOIN org_units ou ON ou.id = rel.to_id AND ou.tenant_id = rel.tenant_id AND ou.is_active = true
        ), expanded_access AS (
         SELECT direct_access.user_id,
            direct_access.tenant_id,
            direct_access.org_unit_id,
            direct_access.root_org_unit_id,
            direct_access.relationship_id,
            direct_access.access_source
           FROM direct_access
        UNION
         SELECT ea.user_id,
            child.tenant_id,
            child.id AS org_unit_id,
            ea.root_org_unit_id,
            ea.relationship_id,
            ea.access_source
           FROM expanded_access ea
             JOIN org_units child ON child.parent_id = ea.org_unit_id AND child.tenant_id = ea.tenant_id AND child.is_active = true
        ), admin_access AS (
         SELECT u.id AS user_id,
            ou.tenant_id,
            ou.id AS org_unit_id,
            ou.id AS root_org_unit_id,
            NULL::uuid AS relationship_id,
            'tenant_admin'::text AS access_source
           FROM current_context ctx
             JOIN users u ON u.id = ctx.user_id AND u.tenant_id = ctx.tenant_id AND (lower(u.role) = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'super_admin'::text]))
             JOIN org_units ou ON ou.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND ou.is_active = true
        )
 SELECT DISTINCT expanded_access.user_id,
    expanded_access.tenant_id,
    expanded_access.org_unit_id,
    expanded_access.root_org_unit_id,
    expanded_access.relationship_id,
    expanded_access.access_source
   FROM expanded_access
UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT admin_access.user_id,
    admin_access.tenant_id,
    admin_access.org_unit_id,
    admin_access.root_org_unit_id,
    admin_access.relationship_id,
    admin_access.access_source
   FROM admin_access;
